verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You should be loved
By the ones You've redeemed
You should be loved
By the ones You've made clean

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Worthy of the hearts
Of the ones You've redeemed
Worthy of the hearts
Of the ones You've made clean

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
You should have all our hearts
We're the ones You've redeemed
You should have all our hearts
We're the ones You've made clean

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We give you all our hearts
We're the ones You've redeemed
We give you all our hearts
We're the ones You've made clean
